chapters.title: What Entra Connect does not do

takeaways: Microsoft Entra Connect is the controlled bridge that syncs selected users, groups and details from on-premises Active Directory to Microsoft Entra ID, with Active Directory remaining the source of authority.
Password hash synchronization fits most organizations, pass-through authentication keeps the local directory in every password check, and federation suits existing sign-in systems.

Entra Connect Health warns when sync stops, which matters most when disabled accounts must also lose cloud access, and Entra Connect is neither a backup nor a replacement for MFA or conditional access.
hook: Duplicate accounts, separate passwords and leavers who keep cloud access are classic hybrid identity problems. This episode explains Microsoft Entra Connect in plain English for IT admins and anyone running Active Directory alongside Microsoft 365. You will learn how sync, authentication and health monitoring work together and where the tool's limits are.
